blocking_issues: [API/Code Accuracy & Skill Quality — Static Syntax Error + ADK 2.0 Contradictions] `.agents/skills/adk-coding-agent-build/references/adk-core-and-setup.md` Section 6 (lines 282-352) contains a stale pre-alignment ADK 2.0 snippet and rules that both fail at runtime and contradict the verified ADK docs and sibling references (`agent-architectures-and-workflows.md`, `graph-and-dynamic-workflows.md`): (a) lines 325-327 use invalid 3-tuple routed edges `(verify_tests, planner, "retry")`, `(verify_tests, finish_node, "pass")`, `(verify_tests, fallback_node, "__DEFAULT__")` — `Workflow` edge tuples parse chains of `NodeLike` objects and raise `WorkflowConfigurationError` on string route elements (must use `(verify_tests, {"retry": planner, "pass": finish_node, DEFAULT_ROUTE: fallback_node})` or explicit `Edge(from_node=..., to_node=..., route=...)`, per `graphs_routes.md`); (b) lines 298 & 337 falsely claim `output_schema` is mandatory on `LlmAgent` workflow nodes to avoid `types.Content` errors (contradicting `graphs.md`, `graph-and-dynamic-workflows.md`, and `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py`, where `LlmAgent` nodes without `output_schema` pass `str` to downstream `FunctionNode`s); (c) line 306 stores `ctx.attempt_count` as a workflow loop iteration counter, even though `ctx.attempt_count` is `RetryConfig`'s per-node retry counter and resets on pauses/re-entries (`graphs_retry.md`); (d) line 341 misnames `mode="task"` delegation tools as `request_task_{name}` (per `workflows_collaboration.md`, delegation tools are named directly after each subagent, while `finish_task` completes the leaf task); (e) line 339 recommends raw `Event(content=types.Content(...))` instead of Python's `Event(message="...")` (`graphs_data-handling.md`); (f) line 340 makes ungrounded `interrupt_id`/`ctx.resume_inputs` claims contradicting `graphs_human-input.md` (handoff `rerun_on_resume=False` vs orchestrator `rerun_on_resume=True` + `ctx.run_node()`); (g) line 351 omits Python 2.0 deprecation warnings for `SequentialAgent`/`ParallelAgent`/`LoopAgent` (`workflows_patterns.md`). Replace Section 6's duplicated prose/snippet with a concise, accurate summary (using valid dict-routed edges and `Event(message=...)`) that defers deep patterns to `references/agent-architectures-and-workflows.md` and `references/graph-and-dynamic-workflows.md`.

[Doc Coverage & API/Code Accuracy — Outdated `output_schema` + `tools` Contradiction] Five locations still assert that setting `output_schema` disables tool calling on a Python `LlmAgent`: `workshop/01-LAB-SETUP-AND-BUILD-ADK.md:375`, `.agents/skills/adk-coding-agent-build/SKILL.md:75`, `.agents/skills/adk-coding-agent-build/references/adk-core-and-setup.md:121, 362`, `starter/coding_agent/agent.py:186`, and `solution/coding_agent/agent.py:290-291`. This directly contradicts `adk_arch_docs/agents_llm-agents.md:477-480, 510` (in Python, ADK supports `output_schema` and `tools` together — Gemini models on Google Cloud accept both in one request, while other models fall back to an injected `set_model_response` tool that can be unreliable, so separating formatting into a sub-agent/downstream node is a reliability best practice rather than a hard ban) AND directly contradicts `.agents/skills/adk-coding-agent-build/references/agent-architectures-and-workflows.md:210-218` (`flight_agent` uses both `output_schema=FlightResult` and `tools=[search_flights, book_flight]`). Update all 5 locations to reflect the accurate Python ADK rule.

[Whole-Workshop Alignment & API/Code Accuracy — Lab 1 Part B Diverges from `starter/` & `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py`] `workshop/01-LAB-SETUP-AND-BUILD-ADK.md` Part B does not match the actual starter/solution implementation and includes a loop bug: (a) Graph workflow diagram & prose (`01-LAB-SETUP-AND-BUILD-ADK.md:475-496`) depict a separate `fixer_agent` target on `NEEDS_FIX`, state `verdict_router` reads `ctx.state.get("fix_attempts", 0)`, and emit `state={"fix_attempts": attempts + 1, "code": ..., "findings": ...}`, whereas `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py:321-342` and `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:465-676` have no `fixer_agent` (routing `NEEDS_FIX` back directly to `coder_agent`), inject `fix_attempts: int = 0` via ADK state parameter binding, and emit `state={"fix_attempts": next_attempt, "latest_findings": findings, "checks_passed": False}`; (b) Dynamic workflow snippet (`01-LAB-SETUP-AND-BUILD-ADK.md:519-542`) calls a non-existent `_combine_findings(...)` helper (actual helper is `_format_check_findings`), runs pytest/ruff before `fixer_agent` inside `for attempt in range(settings.max_fix_rounds):` so the final fix round is never re-verified (unlike `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:806-835` which runs initial checks before the loop and re-runs checks after every `fixer_agent` fix), and passes `str(code_summary)` instead of the structured payload dict to `request_human_approval`; (c) Collaborative snippet (`01-LAB-SETUP-AND-BUILD-ADK.md:434-440`) omits `output_schema=CodeReviewReport` on `code_reviewer`, which both `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py:302` and `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:405` require. Align Lab 1 Part B's Mermaid diagram, code snippets, and bullet points with `starter/` and `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py`.

blocking_issues: [API/Code Accuracy & Whole-Workshop Alignment — Attendee Runtime `NameError` Between Lab 1 Part B Step 7 & `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py`] `workshop/01-LAB-SETUP-AND-BUILD-ADK.md:568` (inside Step 7: "Implement `# TODO(lab-1)` in `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py`") instructs attendees to call `_build_final_report(code_summary=str(code_summary), findings=latest_findings, fix_attempts=attempts_used, approval_note=approval_note)`, and `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py:333, 370` instructs attendees to invoke optional Lab 4 `callbacks["after_agent_callback"]` on completion, yet `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py` NEVER defines `_build_final_report` (nor `_attach_optional_callbacks`, `_invoke_optional_after_agent_callback`, or `_coerce_check_outcome` — all of which exist only in `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:163-201, 307-358`). An attendee following Lab 1 Part B Step 7 verbatim hits `NameError: name '_build_final_report' is not defined` at runtime. Fix: add `_build_final_report` (and `_attach_optional_callbacks`, `_invoke_optional_after_agent_callback`, plus `import inspect, shutil, sys` if helpful for the `pytest`/`ruff` check commands) as pre-provided helpers in `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py` so Lab 1 Step 7's starter snippets execute cleanly with zero missing symbols.

[API/Code Accuracy — Multi-Turn Session State Leak (`fix_attempts`) in `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:586-675` (`build_graph_coding_workflow`)] In `build_graph_coding_workflow()`, `verdict_router(ctx, node_input, fix_attempts: int = 0)` reads session-scoped `fix_attempts` (not `temp:`), increments it via `Event(state={"fix_attempts": next_attempt, ...})` on `"NEEDS_FIX"`, and preserves `"fix_attempts": fix_attempts` when routing to `"PASS"` or `"NEEDS_APPROVAL"` so `finalize_report` can read it across HITL pauses. However, `finalize_report` (`solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:674`) returns `adk_v2.Event(message=report, output=report)` WITHOUT resetting `fix_attempts` or `latest_findings` in session state. Consequently, in any multi-turn session under `AGENT_ARCHITECTURE=graph` (such as Lab 1's own two-turn `adk web` test), Turn 2 enters `verdict_router` with Turn 1's stale `fix_attempts` value — if Turn 1 hit `MAX_FIX_ROUNDS=3`, Turn 2 executes zero fix rounds on failing checks and misreports Turn 1's attempt count in Turn 2's report. Fix: reset per-turn workflow state on terminal completion in `finalize_report` (`return adk_v2.Event(message=report, output=report, state={"fix_attempts": 0, "latest_findings": ""})`) — keeping state intact across HITL pauses while guaranteeing Turn 2 starts fresh at `fix_attempts=0` — and note the reset cleanly in `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py:334` and `workshop/01-LAB-SETUP-AND-BUILD-ADK.md:500`.
improvements: [solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:654-665, 868-873] Normalize HITL `RequestInput` approval responses consistently between `graph` and `dynamic` modes: `finalize_report` in `build_graph_coding_workflow()` cleanly formats `ApprovalDecision`, `Mapping` (deserialized JSON dict with `"approved"`), and plain `str`, whereas `dynamic_coding_workflow()` only checks `isinstance(decision, ApprovalDecision)` and falls back to raw dict `str` representation when ADK deserializes the reply as a `dict`. Extract a shared `_format_approval_note(decision: Any) -> str` helper used by both workflows (and expose it in `starter/coding_agent/architectures.py` as well).

[solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:276 & starter/coding_agent/architectures.py:224] Prevent orphan `pytest`/`ruff` subprocesses if ADK's `@node(..., timeout=30.0)` cancels `_run_workspace_check` mid-execution: wrap `await proc.communicate()` in `try: ... except BaseException: proc.kill(); await proc.wait(); raise` (still re-raising `BaseException` immediately so `asyncio.CancelledError`, `NodeTimeoutError`, and `NodeInterruptedError` propagate unmodified to ADK's retry/HITL runtime).

[.agents/skills/adk-coding-agent-build/SKILL.md:161-170] Align Quick-Start Pattern #3 (`coding_loop`) with the verified pattern in `adk_arch_docs/graphs_dynamic.md:583-590`, `references/graph-and-dynamic-workflows.md:420-427`, and `solution/coding_agent/architectures.py:826-856` by running the initial `await ctx.run_node(run_checks, code)` before the bounded `for` loop and re-running `run_checks` after each `fixer_agent` turn so the final fix iteration is also verified.

[starter/terraform/main.tf:226 & solution/terraform/main.tf:226] Add a brief commented optional `deployment_spec` block showing `# env { name = "AGENT_ARCHITECTURE"; value = "simple" }` alongside `MAX_FIX_ROUNDS` and `ENABLE_HITL_APPROVAL` so Lab 3's environment-variable portability callout (`workshop/03-LAB-DEPLOY-RUNTIME-TERRAFORM.md:138`) is directly discoverable inside `terraform/main.tf` while keeping default Terraform plans unchanged (`AGENT_ARCHITECTURE=simple`).
